import os
from cyhole.helius import Helius
from cyhole.helius.client import PostGetAssetsByOwnerBody

api_key = os.getenv("HELIUS_API_KEY")
if not api_key:
    raise ValueError("HELIUS_API_KEY environment variable not set")

helius = Helius(api_key=api_key)
client = helius.client

wallet_address = input("Enter wallet address: ")

body = PostGetAssetsByOwnerBody(owner_address=wallet_address, limit=1000)
response = client.post_get_assets_by_owner(body)

if response.result:
    for asset in response.result.items:
        print(f"Asset ID: {asset.id}")
        print(f"Name: {asset.content.metadata.name if asset.content and asset.content.metadata else 'N/A'}")
        print(f"Owner: {asset.ownership.owner}")
        print("---")
else:
    print("No assets found")
